description.value: The Empire Hotel New York is steps from Lincoln Center & Central Park on the Upper West Side. The hotel offers stylish Art Deco rooms and a vibrant rooftop bar. It works well for a trip built around concerts, the opera or the ballet at Lincoln Center. Trip.com shows 7.8 / 10 Good 112 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Staff was generally quite nice”. Representative watch-outs: “the hotel is quite old”; “rooms are tiny with old fashioned floor air conditioner which was very loud”.
